title: Who controls an agent with a wallet?
text: Your next shopper could be an agent. Who decides what it can spend?

title: A purchase needs more than a payment.
text: Across different shops, an agent needs a verified identity, shared spending limits, and a payment record you can actually check.

title: Tell your agent what you need.
text: Just ask: buy two pairs of gloves and a box of screws, under fifty euros.

title: Review first. Approve the purchase.
text: Review the matched products, adjust quantities, and approve the total. Planning alone never makes a purchase.

title: Verified before checkout.
text: At checkout, the agent signs each request. Its identity and spending limits are verified before the tool shop settles payment.

title: Know what happened to every payment.
text: Follow every receipt and balance. Duplicate approvals don't repeat purchases. Over-budget requests are blocked.

title: Let agents shop. Keep control of spending.
text: The agent handles the shopping. You keep control of the spending. AgentVault.
